outcome: Autonomic nervous system activity during labor
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with sympathetic nervous system prevalence due to significant vagal withdrawal, potentially influenced by anesthesia, while vaginal delivery showed stable autonomic activity, possibly due to the protective effects of oxytocin.
mod_finding: Sympathetic prevalence was observed during cesarean delivery, characterized by significant vagal withdrawal, while autonomic activity remained relatively stable during vaginal delivery.
